caption: Johann Jakob Frey, Dawn on the Pontine Shore (c. 1843)
alt: An oil sketch of a dawn sky over a flat shore: drifts of small violet clouds high up, a band of white, pink-lit cumulus across the middle, and a thin line of low hills on the far horizon.
bibliography: Frey, Johann Jakob. Dawn on the Pontine Shore (Cloud Study). c. 1843, oil on paper mounted on canvas, private collection. Exhibited in True to Nature: Open-Air Painting in Europe, 1780–1870, Fitzwilliam Museum, Cambridge, and Fondation Custodia, Paris (cat. 108).
title: Dawn on the Pontine Shore
